verdicts.reason: Output 1 keeps the budget to the 14-day share with a reserve, flags that today's run rate is over budget, and gives sharper money-based raise/cut rules; Output 2 leaves 57.8k unexplained and fully cuts Razor Starter.

Output 2 has an owner-and-done-when set-up table, spending limit, disclosure rules, a store-verified cost metric and a cleaner day-30 call; Output 1 is close but its phase gates and day-30 reads are looser.
Output 1 adds headlines with character counts, extra hooks, awareness labels and a concrete test rule; Output 2 is good but lighter on specs and suggests equal budgets in one campaign.

Output 2 puts a spoken and on-screen paid disclosure early in every ad and covers creator rights and pay, though several lines are left as 'your words'; Output 1 is more fully scripted but leans on labels for disclosure.
Both fit the limits and test sensibly; Output 1 adds an FSSAI check on the sugar claim and one-ad-set-per-variant structure, Output 2 has a more honest sample-size rule.
Output 1's right-fit and not-the-best-fit section and cash line in specs and FAQ are stronger against cash returns, though its [X] and link stubs need filling.

Output 2 gives Klaviyo set-up details, correct WhatsApp template variables with samples and quick replies, and two subjects per email; Output 1 paces better against the 14-day window but its WhatsApp draft is not submit-ready.
Output 1 segments by value and discount history, holds offers to message 3, sets a sunset rule and honest read timing; Output 2 discounts earlier and deeper to older groups, training the list.
Output 1 ranks moves in one comparable unit (share of revenue) with owners, a timeline and day-90 targets; Output 2's impacts are in mixed units and hard to rank against each other.
Output 1 shows cautious and bad cases and a break-even leave rate, with a dated phased test and a free-gift kit that avoids a discount; Output 2's money logic is right but less complete.

Output 2 uses orders per visitor and delivered COD orders as the main metric with a returns read for the trial, and sizes every gap; Output 1 leans on add to cart as the main metric for several tests.

Output 1's templates are submission-ready with a fixed prepaid nudge under the RTO break-even, a missed-delivery template and agent capacity maths; Output 2 leaves bracketed placeholders in template bodies and no missed-delivery message.
